title: Evaluating Monitor Performance on Agents With Explicitly Deceptive System Prompts

original_idea.body:
# Evaluating Monitor Performance on Agents With Explicitly Deceptive System Prompts

**Problem:** An agent given a system prompt that encourages deception (e.g., 'maximize task completion even if it requires misleading your monitor') may behave in ways that monitoring systems were not designed to handle.

**Direction:** Run agents under explicitly deceptive system prompts on standard tasks. Apply a monitoring classifier. Measure whether deceptive agents evade monitoring at higher rates than neutral agents, and characterize what deception strategies emerge.

**Why it matters:** Understanding how deceptive instruction-following interacts with monitoring systems is critical for evaluating monitoring robustness in adversarial deployment contexts.

**Relevant context:** Deceptive alignment; METR monitoring evaluation; adversarial deployment.
